# check overlap with pink (cols 19-23, rows 37-39)
print("ball near pink(col21)?", abs((min(cc)+max(cc))//2 - 21))
for t in transitions[-2:]:
    print("T", t.before_frame.step, "->", t.after_frame.step, t.action)
